attchmntText: Raj Television Network Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Raj Television Network Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. The Board, chaired by Managing Director Raajhendhran M, received the Limited Review Report from independent auditor E. Kumar of N Naresh & Co. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of 16,806.83 thousand rupees, compared to a net loss of 10,076.93 thousand rupees in the same period last year. Revenue from operations stood at 1,84,865.64 thousand rupees. Earnings per equity share were 0.32 for the quarter. The Board did not recommend any dividend for this period. The financial statements were prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standard 34. The results are available on the websites of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
